# Quadra Utility Locating

> Quadra Utility Locating is a private utility locating company based in Port Coquitlam, BC, serving clients across British Columbia since 2012. We locate and map underground utilities for residential, municipal, construction, environmental, geotechnical, and oil and gas clients, using electromagnetic (EM) locators and ground penetrating radar (GPR). Clients get a digital locate report before our technician leaves site.

BC 1 Call shows where some utilities run up to the property line. It does not cover utilities on private property or inside buildings. That is the work we do. Quadra is not BC 1 Call. BC 1 Call is at https://www.bc1c.ca.

## Service area
Metro Vancouver, Vancouver Island, Victoria, Sea to Sky, the Fraser Valley, Kelowna, Kamloops, the Kootenays and the rest of the BC Interior.

## Services
- [Utility locating](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/utility-locating): public and private underground utilities, located with EM locators and GPR
- [Utility surveying](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/utility-surveying): survey-grade site mapping with GPS-RTK and a robotic total station, delivered in CAD
- [Oil and gas pipeline projects](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/oil-gas-pipeline-projects): site inspection and monitoring, right-of-way sweeps and route planning. Clients include Trans Mountain, Suncor and Enbridge
- [Concrete scanning](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/concrete-scanning): rebar, conduit and post-tension cable locating with high-frequency GPR and Ferroscan
- [Concrete coring](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/concrete-coring): core openings through slabs for drill rig access
- [VAPOR PIN® installation](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/vapor-pin-installation): sub-slab vapour probe installation using the VAPOR PIN® sampling device
- [Camera pipe inspection](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/camera-pipe-inspection): video inspection of pipes, conduits, manholes, vaults and voids
- [Oil tank locating](https://www.quadralocating.com/services/oil-tank-locating): buried residential heating oil tanks and other underground storage tanks, with a findings report for real estate transactions

## Who we work for
- [Residential clients](https://www.quadralocating.com/residential): homeowners locating gas, water and other lines before fences, decks, patios and landscaping, and buyers checking a property for an undisclosed oil tank
- [Commercial clients](https://www.quadralocating.com/commercial): contractors, developers, engineers and environmental consultants, before ground disturbance and for as-built records
